name: Default
shortDescription: Open source instant messaging and community chat with servers, channels and direct messages, backed by PostgreSQL, Valkey, NATS, Meilisearch and SeaweedFS.

alerts.message: After the first start, open the site and enter the FLUXER_SETUP_TOKEN value from this app's environment variables in the setup wizard to create the first admin account.
Voice and video calls are turned off: the bundled voice server needs public TCP and UDP media ports that an HTTP route cannot carry.
